posts.title: I pledge allegiance
posts.description: I pledge allegiance To the Flag Of the United States of America And to the Republic For which is stands One nation Indivisible With liberty And justice FOR ALL 🇺🇸

posts.title: Maple
posts.description: "Maple" is a narrative poem first published in 1923 in Robert Frost's Pulitzer Prize-winning collection "New Hampshire". The poem is about a woman named Maple who spends her life trying to interpret the meaning behind her name.…

posts.title: Daddy, where did I come from?
posts.description: Preface I wrote this for my daughter. I hope we get to talk about all of this together as she grows up — where she came from, where we came from, and how we think the whole universe came to be. But if something were to happen to me before she's old…
